EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the School of Sustainability at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the Master of sustainable solutions (MSUS) program. The MSUS program is an applied master’s where students complete a capstone instead of a thesis. Students have three capstone options, each of which showcases the student’s applied knowledge in a chosen field within sustainability.
Specific application requirements and top reasons students choose the ASU School of Sustainability are listed on our website. Additionally, we offer several concurrent degrees (with more in the works) and an opportunity to join the Peace Corps while completing a master’s degree through the Master’s International program.
We offer various graduate programs and understand that it may be difficult to determine the best one for your long term goals. We are happy to discuss the differences and answer any additional questions you have. To schedule an in-person, phone or Skype appointment, please call our office at 480-727-6963 during our office hours, Monday through Friday, 9am – 4pm.
Regards,
Katerina Kinast Graduate Academic Success Coordinator ASU School of Sustainability Katie.Kinast@asu.edu
